newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain revises November industrial production data.
newsitem.headline: Spain revises November industrial production data.

text.p: Spain's Economy Ministry said on Thursday the November industrial production figures originally published in January had been revised to show a drop of 1.7 percent year-on-year from a drop of 1.9 percent.
The ministry said earlier that Spain's industrial production rose 1.8 percent year-on-year in December.
Calendar adjusted data was down 2.1 percent in December versus a rise of 0.4 percent in November.
